#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compare architecture prototypes and frozen current Go/JS compiler outputs."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import statistics
import subprocess

ROOT=Path('/Users/0x1/Documents/htdocs/altbak.pub-gopurs')
WORK=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CURRENT=WORK.parent/'json-general-20260922/after-builds/JsonDecoding'
D=runpy.run_path(str(ROOT/'bin/benchmark/json-diagnostic.py'))
env=D['environment']()
manifest=json.loads((CURRENT/'manifest.json').read_text())
assert manifest['sources']==D['fingerprint']('JsonDecoding'),'Current baseline stale'
for filename,key in [('benchmark','binary_sha256'),('benchmark.mjs','js_sha256')]:
    assert D['sha'](CURRENT/filename)==manifest[key]
inputs=list(WORK.glob('*.go'))+[WORK/'go.mod',WORK/'compare.py',WORK/'architecture']
hashes={str(p):D['sha'](p) for p in inputs}
env['DIAG_CORPUS']=str(D['fixtures']('JsonDecoding')/'corpus.json')
oracle=json.loads((D['fixtures']('JsonDecoding')/'expected.json').read_text())
results={model:[] for model in ['go','interfaces','descriptors','js']}
order=list(results)
for iteration in range(3):
    for model in (order if iteration!=1 else list(reversed(order))):
        env['MODEL']=model
        command=([str(CURRENT/'benchmark')] if model=='go' else
                 ['node',str(CURRENT/'benchmark.mjs')] if model=='js' else [str(WORK/'architecture')])
        completed=subprocess.run(command,cwd=WORK,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
        (WORK/f'{iteration}-{model}.json').write_text(completed.stdout)
        result=json.loads(completed.stdout)
        D['validate_result'](result,oracle,'JsonDecoding')
        results[model].append(result)
        print(iteration,model,{p:round(v['time_us']/1000,3) for p,v in result['phases'].items()},flush=True)
assert hashes=={str(p):D['sha'](p) for p in inputs},'Prototype changed during measurements'
assert manifest['sources']==D['fingerprint']('JsonDecoding'),'Baseline sources changed'
medians={m:{p:statistics.median(r['phases'][p]['time_us'] for r in runs) for p in ['parse','decode','combined']} for m,runs in results.items()}
allocations={m:{p:statistics.median(s['allocated_bytes'] for r in runs for s in r['phases'][p]['samples']) for p in ['parse','decode','combined']} for m,runs in results.items() if m!='js'}
report={'protocol':{'rounds':3,'warmups_per_phase':2,'samples_per_phase':5,'cell':'median of process minimum times','GOMAXPROCS':1,'GOGC':100,'pgo':False,'order':order,'middle_round_reversed':True,'file_io_timed':False,'fingerprinting_timed':False,'normalization_timed':False},'medians_us':medians,'allocated_bytes':allocations,'results':results,'current_build':manifest,'prototype_sha256':hashes,'versions':{'go':subprocess.check_output(['go','version'],text=True).strip(),'node':subprocess.check_output(['node','--version'],text=True).strip()},'limitations':['Architecture prototypes written in Go, not generated by gopurs.','Interfaces/descriptors share a schema interpreter; comparison with gopurs also changes control flow, ADT representation and array construction.','No general higher-kinded or arbitrary user DecodeJson instance support.','Same encoding/json parser, prototype omits compiler-generated parser adapters.']}
(WORK/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'medians_us':medians,'allocated_bytes':allocations},indent=2),flush=True)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate 32 different private record types; no operation specialization."""
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
parts = ['// Code generated by generate.py; DO NOT EDIT.\npackage recordprobe\n']
fields = [('id', 'int64'), ('name', 'string'), ('active', 'bool'), ('extra0', 'int64'), ('extra1', 'float64'), ('extra2', 'string')]
for i in range(32):
    order = fields[i % 6:] + fields[:i % 6]
    parts += [f'type private{i} struct {{' + '; '.join(f'{n} {t}' for n, t in order) + '}\n']
    parts += [f'func (r *private{i}) ID() int64 {{ return r.id }}\n', f'func (r *private{i}) Name() string {{ return r.name }}\n', f'func (r *private{i}) Active() bool {{ return r.active }}\n']
    parts += [f'func (r *private{i}) fields() map[string]any {{ return map[string]any{{"id":r.id,"name":r.name,"active":r.active,"x0_{i}":r.extra0,"x1_{i}":r.extra1,"x2_{i}":r.extra2}} }}\n']
parts += ['//go:noinline\nfunc makeInterface(kind int, v input) readable {\nswitch kind {\n']
for i in range(32):
    parts += [f'case {i}: return &private{i}{{id:v.id,name:v.name,active:v.active,extra0:v.extra0,extra1:v.extra1,extra2:v.extra2}}\n']
parts += ['default: panic("bad layout")\n}\n}\n']
(root / 'layouts_generated.go').write_text(''.join(parts))
